name: Full-stack web app
whenToUse: A frontend framework plus its own API or database in one repo (Next.js, Remix, SvelteKit, Rails, Django with templates, Laravel).
mustTrace: The most common write (create/update the core object) from click to database and back
Sign-in: how a session is created and checked on later requests
One background or third-party path (email, payment, webhook) if it exists
questions: Where does business logic live: routes, components, or a service layer?
How is auth enforced, and where can it be forgotten?
What runs on the server vs in the browser?
Which code is safe to change, and which is shared by many features?
